raw_answer_text:
A1: Broadcast — sent to every host on the LAN (dst MAC ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff).
A2: It has no entry for B's IP in its ARP cache before the exchange.
A3: NOT STATED
A4: NOT STATED (the file shows other hosts on the LAN as having "heard, ignored" the broadcast, but does not explicitly say whether they send a reply).
A5: Sent directly to just the requesting host (unicast).
A6: It caches the information, resulting in an entry mapping B's IP → aa:bb:cc:... in its table.
A7: It does not know it; that is precisely the information the request is meant to obtain ("who-has B?").
A8: NOT STATED
